_notes: Current daily mer rebuilt from private_finance_data/data.db daily_inputs. blended_mer = Shopify D2C revenue / d2c_ad_spend (Meta + Google + Bing D2C + Reddit + Snapchat + ChatGPT if tracking_verified + TikTok Shopify share). Amazon-bound Bing, AppLovin, Whatnot, TikTok Shop, and Amazon ads are non-D2C lines and remain in total_ad_spend.

bing.note: Bing is live. Campaign 605195379 (bing to amz tumbler listing 1) is Amazon-bound and excluded from Shopify D2C MER. Leftover D2C is JS_SNO_Brand_Beta_Mobile_$24 (~$1/day).

snapchat.note: Snapchat Ads not live. Spend is $0 until a daily row is written. Pipeboard pull is outside this repo.

chatgpt.note: ChatGPT ads tracking is not verified. chatgpt_spend_daily.json / secondary_ads_data.json last updated 2026-06-02. Do not treat as live D2C spend.
